name: PandaX-III
full_name: Particle and Astrophysical Xenon Experiment III
summary: PandaX-III is a gaseous-xenon double-beta-decay project within PandaX. Its Micromegas time projection chamber is a different detector from the liquid-xenon PandaX-II, PandaX-4T and PandaX-20T instruments.
detection_principle: High-pressure xenon with trimethylamine is read out by strip-segmented Micromegas. Two-electron track topology and energy measurements suppress backgrounds near the xenon-136 decay endpoint.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
